title: 第1495章 现在收拾东西立刻给我滚蛋第1494章 后土出手帮孙悟空
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: “吃俺老孙一棍！”
孙悟空也是被打出了真火！
放在以前，孙悟空是不会吃这么大的亏的。
可是今天，站立尊者利用地灵之力，多次将孙悟空直接击飞。
然而就在此时。
九凤单手按在地上。
“地灵之力！封！”
“孙悟空，我要把你像个沙包一样打飞！”
站立尊者得意地说道。
因为这种事情他已经干过很多次了。
然而这一次，出现了意外。
轰！
孙悟空直接一棍子击碎了他手上的地灵锤。
随后如意金箍棒打在他的肩膀上。
咔嚓！
一阵骨骼碎裂的声音传来。
整个左肩完全被击碎了。
是的。
他可没有金刚不坏之身。
虽然他多次把孙悟空击飞，可是孙悟空有金刚不坏之身，可以失败很多次，而他却只能失败一次。
轰！
站立尊者重重地摔在了地上。
孙悟空手持如意金箍，金箍棒的一端已经悬浮在了站立尊者的脸上。
“你这邪神还有何话说？”
是的，虽然这些苦行僧都有着天庭背书，但是在孙悟空看来，他们不过是邪神罢了。
真正的天神，是不可能如此糟蹋百姓的。
大多数苦行僧对待百姓的方式，甚至比一些妖怪都不如。
可是奈何他们是两位圣人的弟子。
“孙大圣都要杀我！”
站立尊者挥手求饶道。
他是真的怕了。
要知道孙悟空之前可是杀过苦行僧的。
很明显，就算杀死这些苦行僧，三大古神也不会管。
“想要活命，释放这里的百姓！”
“孙大圣，小神并没有囚禁百姓，何来释放一说？”
“还敢狡辩，你不允许百姓躺下睡觉，这不就是变相的囚禁吗？”
“立刻下令，允许百姓躺下休息睡觉。”
“同时下令，立刻停止一切挖矿的活动。”
这一次，孙悟空并没有要求苦行僧发天道誓言。
毕竟很快，后土娘娘将会降临这片土地。
content_en:
"Take a stick from my old grandson!"
Sun Wukong was also hit with real fire!
In the past, Sun Wukong would not have suffered such a big loss.
But today, the Standing Master used the power of the earth spirit to knock Sun Wukong away many times.
But at this moment.
Jiufeng pressed down on the ground with one hand.
"The power of the earth spirit! Seal!"
"Sun Wukong, I'm going to blow you away like a sandbag!"
The standing venerable said proudly.
Because he has done this kind of thing many times.
But this time, something unexpected happened.
boom!
Sun Wukong smashed the earth spirit hammer in his hand with a stick.
Then the Ruyi Golden Cudgel hit him on the shoulder.
Click!
There was a sound of bones breaking.
The entire left shoulder was completely shattered.
Yes.
He is not indestructible.
Although he knocked Sun Wukong away many times, Sun Wukong has an indestructible body and can fail many times, but he can only fail once.
boom!
The standing venerable fell heavily to the ground.
Sun Wukong holds a Ruyi golden hoop, and one end of the golden hoop has been suspended on the face of the standing venerable.
"What else can you say, you evil god?"
Yes, although these ascetics have the endorsement of heaven, in Sun Wukong's view, they are nothing more than evil gods.
It is impossible for a real god to ruin the people like this.
The way most ascetics treat the people is even worse than some monsters.
But they are the disciples of two saints.
"Sun Dasheng is going to kill me!"
The standing venerable waved his hand and begged for mercy.
He was really scared.
You must know that Sun Wukong has killed ascetics before.
Obviously, even if these ascetics are killed, the three ancient gods will not care.
"Hmph!"
"If you want to survive, free the people here!"
"Sun Dasheng, the little god has not imprisoned the people, so how can he release them?"
"You still dare to argue that you don't allow people to lie down and sleep. Isn't this just a disguised form of imprisonment?"
"Immediately give an order to allow the people to lie down and rest and sleep."
"At the same time, we ordered that all mining activities be stopped immediately."
This time, Sun Wukong did not ask the ascetic to take an oath of heaven.
After all, Queen Houtu will come to this land soon.
title_en: Chapter 1495: Pack your things now and get out of here immediately. Chapter 1494: Houtu takes action to help Sun Wukong.
